## 💡 Feature Request

Hello! We love hearing new ideas from our community and team. Before we talk about the solution, we want to make sure we deeply understand the problem you're trying to solve.

### What problem are you trying to solve?
<!-- Please describe the pain point or the limitation you are currently facing. (e.g., "I'm always frustrated when I have to click 5 times to export a report...") -->

### What does your ideal solution look like?
<!-- Describe the feature you want to see implemented. How would it work? What would it look like? -->

### Are there any alternative solutions?
<!-- Have you considered other ways to solve this problem? If so, why do you prefer the solution you described above? -->

### Additional context or mockups
<!-- Feel free to attach screenshots, design mockups, or links to other apps that do this well! -->
